title: Puthu Paatu
desc: When a woman falls in love with her brother's personal manager, she believes their connection is genuine. However, when she discovers he's already in a relationship she is devastated.

title: Varuvan Manikandan
desc: An ardent devotee of Lord Ayyappan narrates tales of various miracles performed by the Hindu deity where the Almighty tests the devotion of his followers.

title: Namma Veettu Kalyanam
desc: Two sisters, Meena and Sitha, fall in love with two college professors and get married to them, only to find out that their husbands are unemployed and are posing as professors.

title: Bhama Rukmani
desc: While Bhama loves Nandagopal and wishes to marry him, his heart belongs to Rukmani. Complications arise when he ends up marrying both women.

title: Gandhi Pirantha Mann
desc: Balu, determined to honour his late parents' fight against caste discrimination, takes on the oppressive forces led by Rukmani's father, seeking justice and striving for social reform.
